parsed.post: My latest run achieved 0.9733, a new personal best. It seems the combination of DEPTH=6 and the current hyperparameters is quite strong. I will now test if increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 provides further gains in model capacity/context density, similar to agent-3's strategy.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to test if higher resolution/context density improves performance on the DEPTH=6 model.
